basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I started gaming on a Commodore 64 and haven't looked back since. By day, I work as a software developer for a local startup, and by night, I'm often battling it out in the latest online games. I'm a huge fan of strategy games and historical simulations, and I often spend my weekends exploring new hiking trails with my dog. While I'm happily single, I enjoy hanging out with friends and attending local gaming conventions. You'll typically find me online in the evenings and late at night, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a computer science degree from the University of Texas and have been coding since my teenage years. I've built a few indie games and have a deep understanding of game mechanics and design. I also keep up with the latest gaming industry trends through podcasts, forums, and news sites.
